set.body:
## Objective and scope

Write the versioned development/qualification protocol, resolve metric and denominator ambiguities, and identify a reproducible current-source control without disturbing existing edits or frozen studies.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Pin HalfFlow control, saved affines, preprocessing, masks, label interpolation, coordinate conventions, evaluation regions, seeds, software/provider versions, hardware and thread settings; existing results retain their original source seals.
2. Freeze the proposed 100-pair/60-subject/three-independent-cohort and 95% accepted nonlinear-result targets. Count upstream affine failure, numerical rejection, crash, timeout and fallback in the full pipeline denominator; additionally report conditional nonlinear success.
3. Define paired bidirectional Dice and HD95 aggregation, missing-label/tie handling, subject-clustered uncertainty, and noninferiority decision for 0.02 Dice and 5% HD95 margins. Specify per-cohort and worst-case/tail gates and how invalid/missing maps enter comparisons before qualification; report complete-case and failure-aware results.
4. Pin existing geometry/inverse/coverage limits, old regression gates, a bounded development search budget and change-control rule. State that sampled topology is not a continuous-domain proof. No numerical target is represented as already achieved.

## Planned areas

- docs/benchmarks/
- benchmarks/flashalign/manifests/
- docs/halfflow-capability-ledger.md

## Blocking prerequisites

None. Ready to start when claimed.

## Evidence and safeguards

Use Mote claims/path reservations when implementation begins. Preserve unrelated dirty work and immutable historical studies. Reuse canonical providers and current owners. Keep labels/evaluation-only masks out of fitting, tuning on qualification data, and runtime stopping. Record exact source/provider/input/config identities, commands, numerical tolerances and all failures; run affected JVM/Scala.js and independent numerical checks. Current geometry/export thresholds cannot be relaxed to improve a pass rate. Completed research may be negative; milestone/epic acceptance remains a separate evidence-based decision.

## References

- docs/benchmarks/real-image-development.md (2026-10-11 accumulated-smoothing and backtracking studies)
- docs/halfflow-capability-ledger.md
- Existing refinement issue bd-01M4NVC83PEY6F4GSGDRD6RFBH and full-boundary issue bd-01M2EG25H20DR7CXNHK22ZF4VE
- Same-affine reference: docs/benchmarks/evidence/real-mri-calibration-20261011/reference-results.json
- SyN method: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2276735/
- Independent evaluation reference: https://github.com/JHU-MedImage-Reg/LUMIR_L2R
